channel.title: Blocktape
channel.description: Blocktape reports crypto news: exchange and market moves, protocol upgrades, token launches, security incidents, regulation and enforcement across chains.

item.title: Reading a DeFi Smart Contract Audit Report
item.description: What to look for in a DeFi smart contract audit report: confirm scope, review severity and fix status, then match the audited commit to the deployed source.

item.title: Stablecoin Yield Costs: Price a $10,000 Position
item.description: The total yearly cost of keeping a stablecoin yield position in DeFi is gas plus fees: calculate it by chain, balance, claims and vault terms before comparing yield.

item.title: How do Morpho vaults differ from Morpho Blue markets?
item.description: Morpho vaults pool one asset across curated Morpho Blue markets; direct lending picks one market, giving lenders more control and a concentrated risk choice.

item.title: Base sequencer fees: From Ethereum costs to revenue
item.description: How Base makes money from sequencer fees: it collects L2 execution and data fees, pays Ethereum to post transaction batches, then keeps the remainder.

item.title: Zodia Custody breach exposed limited client and staff data
item.description: Zodia Custody says an intruder accessed limited client and employee contact data after probing its platform, while its investigation found no unauthorised transactions.

item.title: EU proposal targets crypto networks in Russia sanctions package
item.description: The European Commission proposed new Russia sanctions on Nov. 23, including crypto and payment network measures that could reach third-country providers aiding evasion.

item.title: USDC sent to an Ethereum-only exchange on Polygon
item.description: Sent USDC on Polygon to an Ethereum-only exchange? Often it can be recovered, but only the exchange can retrieve it. Check the transaction and request recovery.

item.title: How to pay with xDai on Gnosis Chain from your wallet
item.description: How to pay with xDai on Gnosis Chain: select the network, send xDAI to the recipient’s address, keep extra for gas, and track confirmation on GnosisScan.

item.title: How does Shibarium change SHIB fees and wallet use?
item.description: What is Shibarium used for? It handles lower-cost SHIB transfers and swaps, with BONE for gas; see how it compares with Ethereum and when to switch.

item.title: Batch or one-by-one revokes when cleaning up approvals
item.description: Batch revoke vs one-by-one token approval revoke: start with individual checks for a first cleanup; batch stale approvals once you can identify every spender.

item.title: EU proposal targets crypto networks and 60 Russian banks
item.description: The European Commission’s 22nd Russia sanctions package would target crypto and payment networks, extend bans to about 60 banks and bar Russian-flag teams from EU sports.

item.title: Why wallets treat custom networks differently: What changes
item.description: Why does my wallet treat custom networks differently from built-in ones? Built-in networks include wallet-chosen details; custom ones need your checks.

item.title: When Are Ethereum Gas Fees Lowest for Sui? Timing a Deposit
item.description: Ethereum gas fees are lowest when block demand is low; there is no reliable hour. Compare a live estimate with the Suibridge quote before signing.

item.title: RPC URLs in EVM network directories: who reviews them
item.description: Maintainers review RPC submissions before listing them; providers run the endpoints. Learn what Chainlist checks and what your wallet confirms.

item.title: Gnosis Chain Uses: Payments, DeFi and Low-Cost Validation
item.description: What is Gnosis Chain used for? It supports low-cost payments, DeFi, DAO tools and validating, with xDAI gas and a route in through Gnosis Bridge.

item.title: EU proposal targets 60 Russian banks and crypto networks
item.description: The European Commission proposed sanctions on Nov. 23 targeting 60 Russian banks and crypto networks, tightening financial pressure and barring Russian teams from EU sports.

item.title: Suibridge vs an Exchange Withdrawal When Gas Is High
item.description: Is it worth bridging a small amount to Sui when ETH gas is high? Usually not: compare the fixed deposit fee with your transfer, then wait or withdraw through an exchange.

item.title: DOJ seeks forfeiture of $1.1B in USDC tied to Binance hack
item.description: The Justice Department filed a civil forfeiture claim for more than $1.1 billion in USDC tied to Binance’s October hack, while about $2.35 billion remains in linked wallets.

item.title: CFTC Clears Backpack and tZERO Derivatives Venues
item.description: The CFTC designated exchange operators for Backpack and tZERO and registered their clearing affiliates, opening a regulated route for new derivatives markets.

item.title: How to Borrow Stablecoins Against Bitcoin and Keep BTC
item.description: How to borrow stablecoins against Bitcoin in DeFi: wrap BTC as WBTC on Ethereum, supply it as collateral, and borrow DAI or USDS while tracking liquidation risk.
